sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Saurabh Kumar Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shiv Shanker Prasad,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A for the State as also perused the record.

This application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking direction to the court below for early disposal of Case No. 247 of 2021 (Heena Bano Vs. Mahtab), under Sections 498A, 323, 504,
506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, pending in the Court of learned Trial Court / Judicial Magistrate Fast Track Court (Female) Azamgarh.

entities.text: Case No. 247 of 2021 (Heena Bano Vs. Mahtab)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the fact that the case has remained pending since 2021.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, preferably within a period of two years from the date of production of a certified copy of this order, if there is no other legal impediment.
